location.ref: The Path of the Masters, on the audible life stream

paraphrase: The creative power of the Supreme flows out as a current of sound and light (the Word, Shabd, Nām); it can be heard within by a soul withdrawn to the eye centre under a living Master, and followed back to its source.
speaker: Julian Johnson
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only.

location.ref: The Path of the Masters, on saints and incarnations

paraphrase: The incarnations (avatāras) come from the regions of the negative power to restore order in the world; the Saints come from the highest region to take souls back home; hence the Saints are above the incarnations.
speaker: Julian Johnson
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
